limitations: One task per experiment, same model family, fresh conversation contexts. No OS-enforced isolation.
Discovery agent seeded searches with known tool names and omitted first raw response; only later repeated capture survives.
Source mutation tools were favored by the discovery agent; input-variant audit versus source mutation wording was not experimentally controlled.
Unknown/error and deliberately misattributed samples are accounting diagnostics, not independently established stock-policy violations.
Integration agent downloaded historical trial documentation linked from public llms.txt; this was not documentation-naive integration.
Baseline repo revision was frozen before a separate public docs commit; actual downloaded docs revision is retained.
Offline replay is a code regression check, not a fresh agent run or repeatable web-search result.

redactions.change: Machine-specific workspace prefix replaced with <WORKSPACE>; original retained locally.

third_party_content: Search page bodies retained in local scratch only; public archive contains query text, titles, URLs, hashes and observed choices, not copied third-party articles.
